about.heading: What is Ayurveda?
about.principle: Based on the basic principle of "Prevention is better than Cure"
about.para1: Ayurveda treats the whole person — body, mind, and spirit. It emphasizes prevention and maintenance of health through balance in lifestyle, diet, and herbs.
about.para2: By understanding your unique constitution, Ayurveda provides personalized recommendations for optimal health and vitality.

principles.heading: Principals of Ayurvedic Treatment
principles.shloka:
प्रयोजनं चास्य आयुर्वेदस्य स्वास्थ्यस्य स्वास्थ्य रक्षणं,
आतुरस्य विकार प्रशमनं च
principles.shlokaTranslation: — The twofold purpose of Ayurveda: to protect the health of the healthy, and to relieve the afflicted of disease.

cards.titleEn: Prevent the Diseases or Deformities in Human body (Psychological)

cards.titleEn: Cure the Patient if Gets Ill

meta.description: Learn about our three-generation legacy of authentic Ayurvedic healing since 1975.

hero.title: Our Legacy of Healing
hero.subtitle: A three-generation tradition of authentic Ayurveda, dedicated to serving humanity with trust and care for over five decades.

story.label: Our Story
story.heading: Born from a Passion for Service
story.para1: Our story begins with my grandfather, born on 4th August 1947, who established Shree Mrikula Ji Clinic in 1975.
story.para2: With deep faith in Ayurveda, he dedicated his life to treating people naturally — without any side effects, and with one vision: to serve humanity.
story.founderQuote: Ayurveda is not just treatment — it is a way of life.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.subtext: Simple yet powerful: to create a healthier environment and heal people the natural way.

team.heading: Meet Our Team
team.subtext: Three generations of Ayurvedic expertise — from classical Vaidh wisdom and modern D.Pharma practice to a fresh BAMS graduate and seamless clinic management.

members.name: Vaidh Rajendra Singh
members.bio: Our journey began with Vaidh Rajendra Singh, who completed his Ayurvedacharya and established Shree Mrikula Ji Clinic in 1975. With decades of experience, he specialises in treating typhoid, all types of fever, migraine, and joint pain. Known for his compassionate approach, he treats patients naturally, focusing on root-cause healing without side effects. His philosophy is simple: Ayurveda is a way of life, and health should be accessible to everyone.
members.quote: Ayurveda is a way of life, and health should be accessible to everyone.

members.name: Vaidh Lalitendra Singh
members.bio: With a D.Pharma qualification, Vaidh Lalitendra Singh brings a powerful blend of traditional Ayurveda and modern medicine. He has extensive experience managing typhoid, diabetes, heart problems, blood pressure, piles, paralysis, joint pain, hormonal disturbances, and leucorrhea. His approach combines deep understanding of the body with natural treatments, ensuring every patient achieves holistic wellness.
members.quote: True healing combines the wisdom of tradition with the understanding of modern science.

members.name: Mridul Sengar
members.bio: Mridul Sengar completed his BAMS in 2025 and focuses on in-depth diagnosis and personalised treatment plans for all types of health problems. His precision in understanding complex health issues allows the clinic to treat patients effectively and safely, always prioritising natural healing and lifestyle-based recovery.
members.quote: Precision in diagnosis is the first step to effective and lasting recovery.

members.name: Tanuj Sengar
members.bio: Tanuj Sengar is the backbone of day-to-day operations at Shree Mrikula Ji Clinic. He ensures every patient receives a seamless and caring experience from the moment they arrive. His dedication to smooth clinic management allows the doctors to focus entirely on healing, while patients feel supported, informed, and at ease throughout their treatment journey.
members.quote: A well-run clinic is where healing truly begins — comfort and care start before the consultation.
